'''DarthMolen''' is a Steam Workshop author who published two Star Wars CCG tables for playing [[Star Wars CCG]] in [[Tabletop Simulator]].<ref name="darthdemo" /><ref name="darthent" />

== Service ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Dates !! Service
|-
| 6 June 2017 &ndash; 7 June 2017 || Published Star Wars CCG: Demo and Table (Decipher), a [[Tabletop Simulator]] Workshop table for [[Star Wars CCG]]<ref name="darthdemo" />
|-
| 17 June 2017 || Published Star War CCG: Imperial Entanglement / Diplomatic Mission (Decipher), a [[Tabletop Simulator]] Workshop table for [[Star Wars CCG]]<ref name="darthent" />
|}
